create.name: Joe Stuczynski
create.bio:
Joe Stuczynski is a Reiki master and meditation guide from Cleveland, Ohio, and the founder of Navigating Earth. He holds Usui and Holy Fire III Karuna Reiki master levels, is a certified Theta Healing practitioner and an ordained minister, and has spent years exploring mediumship, psychic and channelling practices. By day he works as a consultant helping organisations, many of them in healthcare, clarify their purpose and values, and he brings the same interest in clear intention to inner life.

Through Navigating Earth he shares guided meditations, sleep stories, spoken mantras and short reflections on purpose, meaning and the difference between spirituality and religion, mostly on Insight Timer and YouTube, where he has also led live group Reiki sessions for audiences across the world. In 2015 he began the Reiki Peace Project, in which volunteers place Reiki-charged spikes in the ground as small acts of intention for peace; it now counts more than seventy placements in nine countries. He is the author of Living and Loving Well, a short workbook on defining your values to guide relationships and choices, and is also an artist and photographer.

flags: Book Living and Loving Well (ISBN 9780615193168) is sold via Lulu; amazon.com /dp/0615193161 returned 500 to curl and WebFetch, so the book is left out.
Email info@navigatingearth.org is the Navigating Earth brand inbox (his own one-person brand).
His site's shop sells anti-war 'Fight War' and 'Peace Revolution' merchandise; peace messaging rather than partisan politics, but noted.
He mentions a career as a healthcare consultant; the bio describes it neutrally and makes no health claims.
No paid offerings with their own URL: no events are scheduled and Reiki sessions are only live on Insight Timer/HeyGo; the page relies on videos and free resources.
left_out: Book Living and Loving Well: no Amazon listing could be verified (Lulu only).
Ghost Writing series and short motivational clips: under 2 minutes.
Interview with Annie Wood: Joe is the interviewer, not the main speaker.
